subject: Capacity handshake & milestone ladder for Dedicated/Private GPU pool
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@clearwater.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morris <evan@clearwater.ai>, procurement@clearwater.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial sizing questions — MAP & lead times

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for yesterday's call. We want to capture the MAP milestones and confirm lead times for Dedicated vs Private deployments because our CTO wants a clear acceptance window before Q1 budget close. High level asks:

- Can you give a realistic H100/A100 lead time delta for Dedicated vs on-prem Private (we're in US-West)?
- What GPU pool sizing do you recommend for a production start at ~50 rps (average prompt length ~250 tokens) with an expected 3x burst factor?
- Any gating from SOC2/data residency that would affect timeline?

If you can drop a draft MAP we can share internally; procurement will want milestones and a rough invoice schedule.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of ML Platforms, Clearwater Health
[Attachment: spec-sheet-clarifications.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@clearwater.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handshake & milestone ladder for Dedicated/Private GPU pool

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. I attached a starting MAP and a procurement timeline PDF that maps out the milestone ladder we typically use (we call it the handshake ladder):

Key summary here:
- Lead times: Dedicated (hosted reserved) H100 pool — 4–6 weeks to delivery from contract signature (regional availability dependent). Private (VPC/on-prem) — 10–14 weeks for initial appliance + networking + audit gating.
- Initial pool recommendation for 50 rps, 250-token avg, 3x bursts: baseline of 8 H100-equivalent GPUs with autoscaling headroom to 16 for burst windows (we break this into tranches to reduce upfront commit).
- SOC2 & data residency: SOC2 evidence review usually takes 1–2 weeks to validate technical artifacts; if you need on-prem deployment we'll coordinate KMS/HSM integration during week 3–6 of onboarding.

I've attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (walks milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria) and procurement_timeline.pdf (invoice milestones and estimated procurement gating).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You review MAP_v1 and mark any internal gating dates (security/legal/procurement).
2) Karthik will add a short note on quantization/instance profiles for cost targets.
3) We schedule a 30-min handshake sync (I propose Sep 3) to agree tranche sizes and signature target.

Are you ok with a Sep 10 target for a first tranche activation if we sign by Sep 7?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@clearwater.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handshake & milestone ladder for Dedicated/Private GPU pool

Adding a few technical clarifications from infra side:

- The "H100-equivalent" call assumes we use a mixed fleet with quantized LLM profiles. For quality-sensitive endpoints we recommend full precision on 2–3 GPUs and quantized runners on the rest to hit cost targets.
- Sizing math (very rough): 50 rps * 250 tokens = ~12.5k tokens/sec; with batching and KV cache we generally see a 6–8x effective throughput uplift. That maps to the 8 GPU baseline if you aim for 99th percentile latency SLO of 250–350ms.
- Lead-time mitigation: we can stage via a short-term Dedicated burst pool (hosted) while Private on-prem procurement completes; this reduces your go-live risk and keeps latency predictable.

I'll attach a short config stub in the MAP under "instance_profiles" — notes on memory/quantization settings and an acceptance test (latency + correctness golden prompts).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah@clearwater.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morris <evan@clearwater.ai>, procurement@clearwater.ai, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handshake & milestone ladder for Dedicated/Private GPU pool

Hannah —

Thanks, team. MAP_v1 looks good as a draft. Procurement asked for a brief summary they can take to finance:

- Tranche 1 (hosted Dedicated burst): 8 H100-equivalent GPUs, target activation Sep 17 (if we sign Sep 7). Invoice milestone at signature (50% of tranche 1), remainder on activation.
- Tranche 2 (Private on-prem initial installation): target delivery Nov 1; SOC2 evidence review week of Oct 12; final acceptance test window Nov 8–15.

Action items from our side: Evan will confirm budget approval by Sep 6. Procurement will send a PO template and a list of required contract redlines by Sep 8.

Confirming the Sep 3 handshake sync — we'll be on the call and expect a short runbook for switching traffic between Dedicated and Private at cutover.

Appreciate the staged approach — keeps our risk low.

Best,
Sarah
Head of ML Platforms, Clearwater Health
[Attachment: procurement_questions.docx (docx)]
